TITLE: Ever Works

INTRO: Connect this organization to an Ever Works organization with an Ever Works integration key (it starts with ew_int_). Tasks, teams, goals, missions, ideas, agents, docs and the inbox then sync in both directions.
CONNECT_SOON: Connecting from this page arrives with the next release of the integration.

CONNECTED.TITLE: This organization syncs with the Ever Works organization {{ name }}.

KEY.TITLE: Create an integration key in Ever Works
KEY.STEP_1: In Ever Works, open Settings → API keys → New key and choose the type Integration (the link below opens it with the "Ever Gauzy" preset).
KEY.STEP_2: Name the key, for example "Ever Gauzy — {{ organization }}".
KEY.STEP_3: Pin the key to the Ever Works organizations to sync.
KEY.STEP_5: Copy the key: it is shown once and starts with ew_int_.
KEY.NO_APP_URL: Open Ever Works and go to Settings → API keys.

CONNECT.API_URL_HINT: For example https://api.ever.works/api. Self-hosted, stage and dev addresses work too (HTTPS, no query or fragment).
CONNECT.KEY_HINT: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
CONNECT.MISSING_SCOPES: The key lacks these scopes of the "Ever Gauzy" preset; what they cover does not sync: {{ scopes }}
CONNECT.MISSING_REQUIRED: The key lacks scopes the connection cannot work without: {{ scopes }}. Create a key with the "Ever Gauzy" preset.
CONNECT.INCOMPATIBLE: This Ever Works speaks integration API v{{ version }}; this Gauzy speaks another version. Nothing can be connected.
CONNECT.EXISTING: This tenant is already connected to the Ever Works tenant {{ tenant }} (key {{ key }}).
CONNECT.STATUS_NOT_ACTIVE: The connection is {{ status }}: resume it or enter a new key from the sync settings first.

ORGANIZATION.TITLE: Map this organization to one of the key's pinned Ever Works organizations.
ORGANIZATION.NONE_PINNED: The key is pinned to no Ever Works organization.

REVIEW.INTRO: Nothing is paired silently: confirm the suggestions, pair by hand, or leave a record unpaired.
REVIEW.AGENTS_INTRO: Ever Works agents become Gauzy employees of kind "agent" when the sync starts. They are managed by Ever Works: edits made in Gauzy are not pushed.
REVIEW.PROJECTS_UNAVAILABLE: Pairing projects with works is not available on this installation yet.

DIRECTIONS.INTRO: Choose what syncs and in which direction. Records that are private in Ever Works never sync.
DIRECTIONS.SYNC_UNLINKED_PROJECT_TASKS: Also sync tasks of projects that are not paired with a work

PREVIEW.INTRO: A dry run: what the first sync reads, pairs and creates. Nothing is written until you start it.
PREVIEW.WEBHOOK_NOT_REGISTERED: Ever Works could not register its webhook ({{ reason }}); the change feed keeps the sync going.
